capabilities: Sync vault files bidirectionally with a Synology NAS
Route traffic over LAN or the QuickConnect WAN relay automatically
Resolve concurrent edits into timestamped conflict copies
Propagate deletions safely through Obsidian's trash
Configure startup sync and periodic background sync intervals
extras: Passwords are sent in encrypted POST bodies and credentials are stored locally in data.json; also available in Chinese documentation. Community-plugin listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Keeping a vault in sync across devices normally requires a paid sync service or installing WebDAV/Docker services on a NAS, which this avoids by using Synology's built-in File Station API.

requires.name: DSM user account with read/write permissions

summary: NAS sync plugin that synchronizes an Obsidian vault with a Synology NAS through the DSM File Station API and QuickConnect relay, with no server-side setup.
